question: What is the average score of Lewis Hamilton among all the Turkish Grand Prix?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(T1.points)
FROM results AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
INNER JOIN PersonalInfo AS T3 ON T1.driverId = T3.driverId
WHERE T2.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND T3.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton'
